create_BaseTrainer: create a BaseTrainer instance with eval_targets, task, metrics, and extra_info arguments
run_evaluate: run evaluation on datasets using BaseTrainer evaluate method to compute metrics and return results
compute_pet_metrics: compute PET metrics by iterating over eval dataloader and aggregating model predictions against labels
evaluate_pet: evaluate a model on batch inputs using candidate log probabilities with optional prototypical centroids
create_optimizer: create an optimizer with grouped parameters for soft mask labels, decay params, and no-decay params
